const SF_TIP: Readonly<{
  EDGE_PAD: 56;
}>;

Defined in: core/tokens/starfield/params/camera.ts:84

Hover/hint tooltip projection — the navigator's position hint clamps the picked body's projected marker inside the canvas edge when the object sits off-screen or behind the camera, so hovering a catalog row locates it at any zoom level. EDGE_PAD is the canvas-space inset (px) that keeps the marker dot and its label readable on the frame edge.
